vocabulary.definition: Expressions that always have the same value.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Expresiones que siempre tienen el mismo valor.

They differ once x is anything but 1.

vocabulary.definition: To rewrite an expression in a shorter form that is still equal to the original.

vocabulary.definitionEs: Términos con la misma letra elevada a la misma potencia, como 2x y 5x.

steps: 1. Equivalent expressions produce the same value for any substitution of the variable

revealWordProblem.title: Apply: Bonus Points
revealWordProblem.text:
Anwar's quiz bowl team must correctly answer the question shown on the screen to earn ten bonus points in their match. The question is: How can you determine if two expressions are equivalent? Describe how to do this in your own words.
Question: How should Anwar's team respond if they want to earn the ten bonus points?
revealWordProblem.imageAlt: A projector screen headed Quiz Bowl, asking how you can determine if two expressions are equivalent.
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: A complete answer names two ways and says why they agree. First, simplify both expressions using the properties of operations — combine like terms and use the distributive property — and see whether they reduce to the same expression, as 3x + 2x + 10 and 5x + 10 both do. Second, substitute the same value for the variable into each expression and check that both give the same result; testing several values makes the check stronger. Equivalent expressions give the same value for every value of the variable, so a single substitution can suggest equivalence but only simplifying proves it.

choiceFeedback: Combine like terms: 4 + 3 = 7, so 4x + 3x = 7x.
4x and 3x are like terms. 4x + 3x = 7x.
Both have the same variable x. Add the coefficients: 4 + 3 = 7.
hints: 4x and 3x share the exact same variable, x — that makes them like terms.
Combine like terms by adding the coefficients (the number parts). The variable tags along unchanged.
Add the coefficients: 4 + 3. Keep the x exactly as it is — no new exponent appears.
hintsEs: 4x y 3x comparten exactamente la misma variable, x: eso los hace términos semejantes.
Combina términos semejantes sumando los coeficientes (la parte numérica). La variable se queda igual.
Suma los coeficientes: 4 + 3. Conserva la x tal cual: no aparece ningún exponente nuevo.

choiceFeedback: You multiplied the 2 by the m but stopped there. The factor outside the parentheses has to reach every term inside.
2 times m is 2m, and 2 times 5 is 10.
Did you forget to distribute the 2 to both terms?
hints: The 2 outside the parentheses must multiply both the m and the 5.
Distribute: write 2 × m and 2 × 5, then join the products with +.
Start: 2 × m = 2m. Now multiply 2 × 5 and add that product on.
hintsEs: El 2 de afuera del paréntesis debe multiplicar tanto a la m como al 5.
Distribuye: escribe 2 × m y 2 × 5, y luego une los productos con +.
Empieza: 2 × m = 2m. Ahora multiplica 2 × 5 y agrega ese producto.

questions.explanation: Multiplying 3 by each term inside the parentheses is the distributive property.
choiceFeedback: The commutative property changes the order of terms, like a + b = b + a. Look at what is happening to the 3 and the terms inside the parentheses instead.
That shows how multiplying across a sum works.
Distributing 3 to both x and 7 gives this pattern.
hints: Watch what happened to the 3: it multiplied the x AND the 7 across the parentheses.
The order didn't change and the grouping didn't just move — a factor was handed out to each term. Which property does that?
Check: 3 × x = 3x and 3 × 7 = 21 — both appear on the right. Name the property that multiplies across a sum.
questions.explanationEs: Multiplicar el 3 por cada término dentro del paréntesis es la propiedad distributiva.
hintsEs: Fíjate en lo que le pasó al 3: multiplicó a la x Y al 7 a través del paréntesis.
El orden no cambió y la agrupación no solo se movió: se repartió un factor a cada término. ¿Qué propiedad hace eso?
Comprueba: 3 × x = 3x y 3 × 7 = 21, y ambos aparecen a la derecha. Nombra la propiedad que multiplica a través de una suma.

reviewHighlights.watchOut: A common mistake in Equivalent Expressions is adding the exponents instead of the coefficients when combining like terms — writing 3x + 2x as 5x² instead of 5x. Remember: 3x means 3 groups of x and 2x means 2 more groups of x, so you add the coefficients (3 + 2 = 5) and keep the variable's power the same (x¹, not x²).

level1.stem: Fill in the box: 3x + 5x + 4 is equivalent to ☐x + 4. What number goes in the box?
level1.stemEs: Completa el recuadro: 3x + 5x + 4 es equivalente a ☐x + 4. ¿Qué número va en el recuadro?
hints: Combine 3x and 5x. The 4 stays the same.
hintsEs: Combina 3x y 5x. El 4 se queda igual.
level1.explanation: Combine the like terms: 3x + 5x = 8x Keep the 4 the same: 8x + 4
level1.explanationEs: Combina los términos semejantes: 3x + 5x = 8x Deja el 4 igual: 8x + 4

level1.stem: Are 4x + 2x and 6x equivalent? Find the value of each when x = 5.
level1.stemEs: ¿Son equivalentes 4x + 2x y 6x? Halla el valor de cada una cuando x = 5.
hints: Put 5 in for x in both expressions.
hintsEs: Pon 5 en lugar de x en las dos expresiones.
level1.explanation: Substitute x = 5 into 4x + 2x: 4 × 5 + 2 × 5 = 20 + 10 = 30 Substitute x = 5 into 6x: 6 × 5 = 30
level1.explanationEs: Sustituye x = 5 en 4x + 2x: 4 × 5 + 2 × 5 = 20 + 10 = 30 Sustituye x = 5 en 6x: 6 × 5 = 30

level1.stem: Fill in the box: 7x + 2x + 1 is equivalent to ☐x + 1. What number goes in the box?
level1.stemEs: Completa el recuadro: 7x + 2x + 1 es equivalente a ☐x + 1. ¿Qué número va en el recuadro?
hints: 7 x's plus 2 x's is how many x's?
hintsEs: 7 x más 2 x, ¿cuántas x son?
level1.explanation: Combine the like terms: 7x + 2x = 9x Keep the 1 the same: 9x + 1
level1.explanationEs: Combina los términos semejantes: 7x + 2x = 9x Deja el 1 igual: 9x + 1

level1.stem: Fill in the box so the expressions are equivalent: 5x + 4x + 3 and ☐x + 3. What number goes in the box?
level1.stemEs: Completa el recuadro para que las expresiones sean equivalentes: 5x + 4x + 3 y ☐x + 3. ¿Qué número va en el recuadro?
hints: Combine the like terms 5x and 4x. The 3 stays the same.
hintsEs: Combina los términos semejantes 5x y 4x. El 3 se queda igual.
level1.explanation: Combine the like terms: 5x + 4x = 9x Keep the 3 the same: 5x + 4x + 3 → 9x + 3
level1.explanationEs: Combina los términos semejantes: 5x + 4x = 9x Deja el 3 igual: 5x + 4x + 3 → 9x + 3

level1.stem: Simplify 6x + 9 + 3x. Then find its value when x = 4.
level1.stemEs: Simplifica 6x + 9 + 3x. Luego halla su valor cuando x = 4.
hints: Combine 6x and 3x first. Then put 4 in for x.
hintsEs: Primero combina 6x y 3x. Luego pon 4 en lugar de x.
level1.explanation: Combine the like terms: 6x + 9 + 3x → 9x + 9 Substitute x = 4: 9 × 4 + 9 = 36 + 9 = 45
level1.explanationEs: Combina los términos semejantes: 6x + 9 + 3x → 9x + 9 Sustituye x = 4: 9 × 4 + 9 = 36 + 9 = 45

hints: Find the terms that have x. Combine only those. The plain number stays alone.
hintsEs: Busca los términos que tienen x. Combina solo esos. El número solo se queda aparte.
level2.explanation: Find the like terms: 3x and 4x Combine them. Keep the 5: 3x + 4x + 5 → 7x + 5
level2.explanationEs: Busca los términos semejantes: 3x y 4x Combínalos. Deja el 5: 3x + 4x + 5 → 7x + 5
choiceFeedback: You added 3, 5 and 4. The 5 has no x, so it is not a like term.
You added 5 and 4. The 4 belongs to 4x, so it is an x term.
You put 3x and 5 together. The 5 has no x.

level2.stem: Fill in the box so the expressions are equivalent: 5(x + 2) and 5x + ☐. What number goes in the box?
level2.stemEs: Completa el recuadro para que las expresiones sean equivalentes: 5(x + 2) y 5x + ☐. ¿Qué número va en el recuadro?
hints: The 5 multiplies both terms inside the parentheses.
hintsEs: El 5 multiplica los dos términos dentro de los paréntesis.
level2.explanation: Multiply 5 by each term: 5 × x + 5 × 2 Simplify: 5x + 10
level2.explanationEs: Multiplica 5 por cada término: 5 × x + 5 × 2 Simplifica: 5x + 10

level2.stem: Fill in the box so the expressions are equivalent: 8x + 3x + 4 and ☐x + 4. What number goes in the box?
level2.stemEs: Completa el recuadro para que las expresiones sean equivalentes: 8x + 3x + 4 y ☐x + 4. ¿Qué número va en el recuadro?
hints: 8 x's plus 3 x's is how many x's?
hintsEs: 8 x más 3 x, ¿cuántas x son?
level2.explanation: Combine the like terms: 8x + 3x = 11x Keep the 4 the same: 8x + 3x + 4 → 11x + 4
level2.explanationEs: Combina los términos semejantes: 8x + 3x = 11x Deja el 4 igual: 8x + 3x + 4 → 11x + 4

level2.stem: Kim says 6x + 2 and 8x are equivalent. They match at x = 1. Test x = 4. What is 6x + 2 when x = 4?
level2.stemEs: Kim dice que 6x + 2 y 8x son equivalentes. Coinciden en x = 1. Prueba con x = 4. ¿Cuánto es 6x + 2 cuando x = 4?
hints: Multiply 6 × 4 first. Then add 2. Compare it with 8 × 4.
hintsEs: Primero multiplica 6 × 4. Luego suma 2. Compáralo con 8 × 4.
level2.explanation: Substitute x = 4 into 6x + 2: 6 × 4 + 2 = 24 + 2 = 26 Substitute x = 4 into 8x: 8 × 4 = 32 Compare the values: 26 ≠ 32
level2.explanationEs: Sustituye x = 4 en 6x + 2: 6 × 4 + 2 = 24 + 2 = 26 Sustituye x = 4 en 8x: 8 × 4 = 32 Compara los valores: 26 ≠ 32

level2.stem: A gym writes the cost of x classes as 3x + x + 10 dollars. This is equivalent to ☐x + 10. What number goes in the box?
level2.stemEs: Un gimnasio escribe el costo de x clases como 3x + x + 10 dólares. Esto es equivalente a ☐x + 10. ¿Qué número va en el recuadro?
hints: x by itself means 1x. Combine 3x and 1x.
hintsEs: x sola significa 1x. Combina 3x y 1x.
level2.explanation: Write x as 1x: 3x + 1x + 10 Combine the like terms: 3x + 1x + 10 → 4x + 10
level2.explanationEs: Escribe x como 1x: 3x + 1x + 10 Combina los términos semejantes: 3x + 1x + 10 → 4x + 10

choiceFeedback: The 4 reached x but not the 3. Distribute it to both terms inside.
The 4 and 3 were added and x attached. They are not like terms; the 4 multiplies each of them.
The 4 reached the 3 but not the x. Distribute it to both terms inside.
level3.explanation: Use the distributive property to multiply 4 by each term inside the parentheses: 4 · x = 4x and 4 · 3 = 12, so the expression is 4x + 12.

level3.stem: Which expression is NOT equivalent to 6x + 9?
hints: Simplify each choice. Look for the one that does not become 6x + 9.
hintsEs: Simplifica cada opción. Busca la que no se convierte en 6x + 9.
level3.explanation: Simplify the first three choices: 3(2x + 3) → 6x + 9; 9 + 6x → 6x + 9; 4x + 9 + 2x → 6x + 9 Distribute the last choice: 6(x + 9) → 6x + 54
level3.explanationEs: Simplifica las tres primeras opciones: 3(2x + 3) → 6x + 9; 9 + 6x → 6x + 9; 4x + 9 + 2x → 6x + 9 Distribuye la última opción: 6(x + 9) → 6x + 54
choiceFeedback: This one is equivalent. 3 times 2x is 6x, and 3 times 3 is 9.
This one is equivalent. Only the order of the terms changed.
This one is equivalent. 4x + 2x combines to 6x.

level3.stem: Lee says 5x + 3 and 8x are equivalent because both equal 8 when x = 1. Test x = 2. What is 5x + 3 when x = 2?
level3.stemEs: Lee dice que 5x + 3 y 8x son equivalentes porque las dos valen 8 cuando x = 1. Prueba con x = 2. ¿Cuánto es 5x + 3 cuando x = 2?
hints: Multiply 5 × 2 first. Then add 3.
hintsEs: Primero multiplica 5 × 2. Luego suma 3.

level3.stem: A gym fee is 2(x + 6) dollars for x months. Which expression is equivalent?
level3.stemEs: La cuota de un gimnasio es 2(x + 6) dólares por x meses. ¿Qué expresión es equivalente?
hints: The 2 multiplies every term inside the parentheses.
hintsEs: El 2 multiplica cada término dentro de los paréntesis.
level3.explanation: Multiply 2 by each term: 2 × x + 2 × 6 Simplify: 2x + 12
level3.explanationEs: Multiplica 2 por cada término: 2 × x + 2 × 6 Simplifica: 2x + 12
choiceFeedback: The 2 must multiply the 6 too.
The 2 must multiply the x too.
You added 2 and 6. The 6 is not an x term.

level3.stem: What number goes in the box so that 3(x + ☐) is equivalent to 3x + 21? Check your answer with x = 2.
level3.stemEs: ¿Qué número va en el recuadro para que 3(x + ☐) sea equivalente a 3x + 21? Comprueba tu respuesta con x = 2.
hints: The 3 multiplies the box. 3 times what number is 21?
hintsEs: El 3 multiplica el recuadro. ¿3 por qué número es 21?
level3.explanation: Distribute the 3: 3(x + ☐) → 3x + 3 × ☐ Work backward: 21 ÷ 3 = 7 Check with x = 2: 3 × (2 + 7) = 27; 3 × 2 + 21 = 27
level3.explanationEs: Distribuye el 3: 3(x + ☐) → 3x + 3 × ☐ Trabaja hacia atrás: 21 ÷ 3 = 7 Comprueba con x = 2: 3 × (2 + 7) = 27; 3 × 2 + 21 = 27

steps.title: Way 1: Simplify both expressions
steps.say: Combine like terms and use the distributive property.

steps.title: Way 2: Substitute the same value
steps.say: Testing several values makes the check stronger.

steps.title: Explain why they agree
steps.math: equivalent → same value for every value of x

workedSteps.answer: Simplify both expressions to see if they match, and substitute the same values to check; only simplifying proves they are equivalent.
